scope: Proposition 3.3 (Local Nash inequality) of the manuscript “Bloch's Law for Finite-Range Heisenberg Ferromagnets in Three Dimensions” (preprints/Blochs-Law-for-Finite-Range-Heisenberg-Ferromagnets-in-Three-Dimensions-October-5-2026/bloch-law-heisenberg.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 271 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4884bc0984dfd0f6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose R ≥ R0 and t is regular for z at radius R. Every nonnegative function v on Ht, supported on slots above BR(z), satisfies ∥v∥ 10/3 2 ≤ CDt(v)∥v∥ 4/3 1 . (3.9) The constant is independent of R, z, t and the unavailable slots.
